message.content:
The loop at lines 9–12 follows `default_table` parents without re-validating each new `j` against `state_count`. Only the initial `j = state` is checked (line 6); subsequent parents (line 11) are never rechecked, so a differential state can point to an out-of-range index, causing out-of-bounds reads of `is_differential`/`default_table`/`accept`, or an infinite cycle.

Answer: 9,10,11
